description: This file contains common Bash utility functions for scripting, including error handling, OS detection, file and directory checks, command existence, file copying, string manipulation, and retry logic.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Outputs an abort message and exits with status 1.

methods.name: warning
methods.description: Prints a warning message to stderr.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Prints an error message and calls abort.

methods.name: echo_array
methods.description: Prints each argument on a new line.

methods.name: what_os
methods.description: Detects the operating system and outputs its name.

methods.name: contains_files
methods.description: Checks if all listed files exist.

methods.name: check_not_empty
methods.description: Ensures a string argument is not empty.

methods.name: check_not_empty_variable
methods.description: Ensures a variable is set and not empty.

methods.name: check_file_exists
methods.description: Checks if a specified file exists.

methods.name: check_file_not_exists
methods.description: Checks if a specified file does not exist.

methods.name: check_file_not_empty
methods.description: Checks if a file exists and is not empty.

methods.name: check_dir_exists
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists.

methods.name: check_command_exists
methods.description: Checks if a command is available in the system.

methods.name: delete_file_if_exists
methods.description: Deletes a file if it exists.

methods.name: copy_files
methods.description: Copies a list of files to a target directory.

methods.name: strip_prefix_and_file_from_path
methods.description: Removes a prefix pattern from a path and returns the directory name.

methods.name: strip_suffix
methods.description: Removes a suffix pattern from a string.

methods.name: print_function_arguments
methods.description: Displays local variables in a function that match a pattern.

methods.name: retry
methods.description: Retries a command multiple times with delay.

methods.name: mac_compatibility
methods.description: Checks OS type and sets readlink command accordingly.
